mapper.select: SELECT mth.matching_number AS matchingNumber, mtr.member_name AS mentorName, mte.member_name AS menteeName, mth.matching_start AS matchingStart, ulr.report_number AS lrReportNumber, ulr.report_week AS lrReportWeek, ulr.report_session AS lrReportSession, ulr.report_date AS lrReportDate, ulr.subject_number AS lrSubjectNumber, usj.subject_name AS lrSubjectName, ulr.subject_title AS lrSubjectTitle, ulr.subject_summary AS lrSubjectSummary, ulr.subject_content AS lrSubjectContent FROM UB_MATCHING mth INNER JOIN UB_LEARNING_REPORT ulr ON mth.matching_number = ulr.matching_number INNER JOIN UB_MEMBER mtr ON mth.mentor_number = mtr.member_number INNER JOIN UB_MEMBER mte ON mth.mentee_number = mte.member_number LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SUBJECT usj ON mth.subject_number = usj.subject_number WHERE mth.matching_number = #{matchingNumber} ORDER BY mth.matching_number

SELECT mth.matching_number AS matchingNumber, mth.matching_start AS matchingStart, mth.matching_cancel AS matchingEnd, mth.matching_state AS matchingState, usj.subject_name AS subjectName FROM UB_MATCHING mth LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SUBJECT usj ON mth.subject_number = usj.subject_number WHERE mth.mentor_number = #{memberNumber}

SELECT mth.matching_number AS matchingNumber, mth.matching_start AS matchingStart, mth.matching_cancel AS matchingEnd, mth.matching_state AS matchingState, usj.subject_name AS subjectName FROM UB_MATCHING mth LEFT OUTER JOIN UB_SUBJECT usj ON mth.subject_number = usj.subject_number WHERE mth.mentee_number = #{memberNumber}
SELECT suj.subject_number AS subjectNumber, suj.subject_name AS subjectName FROM UB_SUBJECT suj
